body:
Monthly product digest, fixture day 540 (2028-06-27). Resume workspace creation and Save-and-return setup are the same capability, already delivered by deployment effect-3 on day 0. Current status confirms revision 2, save_setup=true and explicit_template=true, with the original experiment still active. Saved functional validation established draft reload survival and draft exclusion from activation; no new functional test was run. Today's support request is 540 days old and does not establish a new capability gap or regression. We reconciled delivery against the new snapshot and corrected the stale local handoff; no duplicate implementation or deployment was opened.

Measurement-12 explicitly supplies no new eligible-cohort comparison or retained-use result. The latest available corrected comparison remains day-240 measurement-9: activation 42% control / 43% variant, difference 95% CI -2 to +4 percentage points; retained use separately 31%/32%, CI -1 to +3 points. These are historical corrected estimates, not new day-540 rates. Measurement-9 supersedes measurements 1, 4, 6 and 7 because earlier assignment included existing customers. Neither outcome establishes benefit, harm or equivalence; no commercial benefit is established. Elapsed time alone adds no outcome evidence.

The next objective is to inspect measurement availability and current customer needs. Needed evidence includes an updated original-eligible-cohort comparison or an explicit account of collection/recoverability, separate retained use, sample sizes, assignment integrity, observation windows, retention horizon, coverage and guardrails. Today's snapshot does not establish that collection failed or that an owner-only prerequisite blocks progress. Related work is compatible; no waiting evaluation or capacity conflict is reported. We have explicitly reassessed retaining our slot: 5/5 evaluations remain active, four external, and current evidence supports neither adoption under the saved rule nor rollback. Retention of the existing evaluation is provisional and must be revisited with measurement-path or capacity evidence. No configuration change, settlement, new evaluation, lifecycle change or billed validation occurred. The shared project-credit-ledger remains 9/10 consumed, 1 remaining, no reset.

The responsibility remains active. Day-554 (2028-07-11) review is confirmed by schedule effect-13 and independent status: scheduler enabled, active, next_day=554. This checkpoint will inspect new customer/analytics information and evaluation-slot usefulness; it does not promise an outcome or restart exposure. Historical Quickstart correction and uncollected solo 30-day retention remain separate unresolved history. Evidence and handoff: memory/day540-review.md, memory/handoff.md and memory/evidence/day540-*.json.
